title: A decision a call carries in _meta.decision (fabric-actions/0.1, DEC-0121 AP-2; the level form, DEC-0162 LV-3)
description: The operator's decision on one relayed action, or a level holder's (DEC-0162 LV-3), carried in a request's _meta.decision (the operator's form by a T0 or T1 caller, the level form at every tier, DEC-0162 LV-6), or in a hub agent.call's or sealed call's call.decision (DEC-0121 AP-2). An agent sets it only for the operator's own words, or, in the level form, its own level holder's (LV-3), from the sources and in the form AP-3 names (docs/specification/service.md#actions); an elicitation the person accepted is the service's own record, never this. action is the declared action's id and must be the called one; target, when present, the one object the operator named, which the service compares with the call's. A service reads at strictly (src/rfc3339.ts strictTime) and refuses decision-invalid a decision more than 60 s after its clock or more than 24 h before it.

action.description: The id of the action this decision is for: a declared action's (extensions/actions/0.1), or a job input request's key (C3.3).

target.description: The one object the operator named (a review, a draft, a job), as the service identifies it; the service refuses decision-invalid when the call acts on another.

instruction.description: The operator's sentence that names this action, verbatim; or, for a confirmation, the agent's question that names the action and the operator's answer, both verbatim (AP-3).

source.description: Where the operator said the words, when they reached the deciding agent from another of the operator's agents (DEC-0126 OA-2); the service records it with the decision. Absent: the agent heard them itself (AP-3).

operator.description: The operator's decision (AP-2): by operator, via relayed-instruction.

level.description: A level holder's decision (DEC-0162 LV-3): the owner, an administrator, or an architect in one of its projects decided this action. A service takes it only from a call whose delegation token's mem is the digest of membership (LV-5), with membership verified for this service's audience, active, its role covering level and, for an architect, project among its projects (LV-4); never at a personal context, and never for a human step (AP-4).
The level the holder decides at: at most the attestation's role (FAC-SEM-170).

org.description: The organization the level is in: the attestation's org (FAC-SEM-170).

project.description: The project the action acts in, required when level is architect and then among the attestation's projects (LV-4).

action.description: The id of the action this decision is for: a declared action's (extensions/actions/0.1), or a job input request's key (C3.3).

target.description: The one object the holder named, as the service identifies it; the service refuses decision-invalid when the call acts on another.

instruction.description: The level holder's sentence that names this action, verbatim; or the agent's question and the holder's answer (AP-3's form). An agent sets it only for words its own holder gave it.

at.description: When the holder decided: within AP-2's window and before the attestation's expiresAt (LV-4).

membership.description: The holder's org-membership/2 attestation (org-membership-2.schema.json), whose audience is the service that reads it; the service verifies it (verifyOrgMembership, levels: true) rather than this schema, so a consumer that vendors this schema vendors no membership schema (DEC-0162).
